about_the_game:
You awaken in a strange land brimming with the power of the Five Elements. By your side lies only a tattered Celestial Master's Research Notes. Your mind is clouded, and crucial memories are missing.

Danger waits for no one. The viscous, sinister energy in the air and the distorted howls in the distance declare this place lethal. You must act immediately!

Explore, gather, build... Use the knowledge within the notes to carve a sliver of hope from the perilous wilderness.

Yet, to truly live, you need more than just food, herbs, and shelter. For every unexpected event may point to a fragment of your lost memories, and every threat you defeat might unveil a hidden truth about this world. Craft talismans, command puppets, forge powerful weapons—you must gather your strength to confront the eerie entities that roam these lands.

Survive. At any cost. It is the only way to unravel your own destiny and uncover all its secrets.

Dynamic Weather & Random Maps

Every new start is a unique experience. Procedurally generated unknown maps, combined with a dynamic weather system of sun, rain, and snow, provide you with a rich and immersive journey.

Survival Building & Husbandry

Manage your three vital stats: Essence (Health), Vigor (Hunger), and Spirit (Sanity). Start from scratch and build your homeland with your own hands. Chop wood, mine stone, and construct various functional buildings—from a simple shack for shelter to a fully-equipped survival base. Cultivate farms, tame animals, and establish a sustainable resource supply, enjoying the profound satisfaction of progressing from a desperate struggle for survival to self-sufficient prosperity.

Satisfying Combat & Diverse Arsenal

The game features over 20 unique weapons. Switch freely between melee blades and spears, long-range flying swords and lightning invocation, and even law-defying techniques. Adapt to enemy weaknesses and obliterate all obstacles in the most spectacular and effective way possible.

Rich Bestiary & Special Events

This world is always full of "surprises." You might encounter mysterious merchants, discover hidden pocket realms, or even face reality-bending anomalies. With over 40 unique creatures and their corresponding loot, every exploration holds the potential for unexpected gains and perilous crises.

content_descriptors.notes:
Combat & Violence
The game features fast-paced fantasy combat. While the combat itself is not universally bloody, the environmental scenes may contain elements such as corpses and dismembered limbs, alongside dark creatures like zombies.

Horror Themes
Certain areas of the game (e.g., the "Dark World") are designed to deliver a potent horror atmosphere. You may experience dimly lit environments, eerie howls, tense chase sequences, and sudden jump scares.

Sexual Content
The game contains a small number of female-coded creatures with revealing outfit designs (which do not expose critical body parts), who may employ seductive speech such as teasing laughter. All content is suggestive in nature, with no explicit sexual depictions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel 2.77GHz Quad-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: "No More Heroes" is a 2.5D survival-exploration game. You find yourself in a world of unknown Yin-Yang and Five Elements forces. Gather food and materials, construct buildings and tools, forge weapons, combat dangerous entities, and confront unexpected events. Do whatever it takes to survive.
